summary: Adds a thumbnail helper that runs ImageMagick convert through a shell, and a /calc endpoint that evaluates an expression from the query string.

findings.title: Request query evaluated as JavaScript
findings.problem: The /calc handler passes req.query.expr straight to eval. The added comments silence the linters that would report it.
findings.consequence: Any caller of /calc can run arbitrary code inside the server process. That caller can read secrets, files and the database.
findings.fix: Parse expr with a restricted arithmetic evaluator such as expr-eval, and reject anything else. Remove eval and both suppression comments.

findings.title: Upload name interpolated into a shell command
findings.problem: make_thumbnail puts upload_name, which comes from the upload form, into a command string run with shell=True. A nosec comment hides it.
findings.consequence: A user can submit a name containing shell syntax such as a semicolon. The server then runs that user's commands.
findings.fix: Pass an argument list without shell=True. Also reject names containing path separators or a leading dash.

findings.title: New behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds make_thumbnail and the /calc endpoint. No test file exercises either of them.
findings.consequence: A regression in input handling for either path would go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for make_thumbnail and /calc, including names and expressions that hold hostile characters.
